query: UPDATE assistant_actions a SET batch_verdict=CASE WHEN a.state IN ('queued','partial','failed') THEN a.state ELSE 'unknown' END FROM assistant_batches b WHERE a.workspace_id=$1 AND a.user_id=$2 AND a.login_id=$3 AND a.batch_id=$4 AND b.workspace_id=a.workspace_id AND b.id=a.batch_id AND a.batch_index=b.next_index AND a.state IN ('dispatching','completed','unknown','queued','partial','failed') AND a.batch_verdict IS NULL
